question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH cons_points AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, SUM(points) as constructor_points
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.race_id = res.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001 AND res.points > 0
    GROUP BY r.year, constructor_id
),
min_points_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(constructor_points) as min_points
    FROM cons_points
    GROUP BY year
),
min_constructor_per_year AS (
    SELECT mp.year, mp.min_points, cp.constructor_id, cp.constructor_points
    FROM min_points_per_year mp
    JOIN cons_points cp ON mp.year = cp.year AND mp.min_points = cp.constructor_points
)
SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) as seasons_with_min
FROM min_constructor_per_year mcp
JOIN constructors c ON mcp.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name
ORDER BY seasons_with_min DESC, c.name
LIMIT 5
